decisions.reason: Requiring delivery of editable source files for self-service PDF export does not change the existing package requirement for fonts, icons, and reusable design assets.
The source-file delivery and independent PDF-export workflow do not alter the existing editable-field list, editing purpose, or assessment-date field format.
The source message's separate DX18 and DX19 wording change is already represented by a same-message MODIFY; the self-service export decision adds no further narrative-state change.
Editable source-file delivery does not change the required DX17–DX20 variant codes, their editability, or their score-and-risk selection basis.
The export workflow does not change the content, format, detail level, or presentation goal of the front-page result drivers.
The source decision does not modify the scoring-summary table or any of its required fields.
The self-service PDF-export workflow does not alter the vehicle identifier or its clean report-line presentation.
Delivering editable source files for independent export does not change the approved visual standard, reference-based theme, or cross-variant design direction.
The export decision does not alter the approved assessment-date, gated-driveways, or assessment-note copy.
The source-file delivery and export workflow do not change footer presence, content, or page coverage.
The source decision does not modify the front-page result fields, score heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The self-service export workflow does not change internal-header coverage, presentation, or example text.
